# Ventus AI

> Ventus AI is an AI behavioral intelligence and personalization engine for financial institutions. It enriches raw bank transaction data into five signal layers — spending habits, life events, financial signals, demographics, and risk — and activates them as personalized offers, product recommendations, rewards, campaigns, and advisor conversations.

Ventus AI goes beyond basic enrichment. Traditional enrichment providers clean and categorize transactions (merchant name, MCC, category). Ventus operates at the intent and life-event layer: it interprets a customer's transaction history to infer lifestyle pillars, detect life events (home purchase, new child, college preparation, relocation), read financial signals (loans, mortgages, leases, investments), and infer demographic context — then turns those signals into hyper-personalized actions with explicit value math.

Built for banks and credit unions: digital banking teams, rewards and loyalty teams, marketing/campaign teams, wealth management divisions, and executives.

## Key facts

- Category: AI behavioral intelligence and personalization engine for financial institutions.
- Inputs: card and account transaction data (no PII stored; anonymized transaction signals only).
- Outputs: enriched transactions, five behavioral signal layers, next-best offer, next-best product, next-best conversation, segment-of-one campaigns, and portfolio analytics — available via API.
- Integration: no core banking changes required; transaction data in, enriched intelligence out through a simple API.
- Security: enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure, end-to-end encryption, data isolation per institution. SOC 2 certification in progress.
